```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: 'asis'

cloud_name   <- "fqsd4oea"     
folder_path  <- "cat_images/img-_"     # use %03d below instead of %d if files are padded (img-001)
total_images <- 358

base <- sprintf("https://res.cloudinary.com/%s/image/upload", cloud_name)

image_list <- lapply(1:total_images, function(i) {
  list(
    full  = sprintf("%s/f_auto,q_auto,w_1600/%s%d.jpg", base, folder_path, i),
    thumb = sprintf("%s/f_auto,q_auto,w_160,h_120,c_fill/%s%d.jpg", base, folder_path, i)
  )
})

json_images <- jsonlite::toJSON(image_list, auto_unbox = TRUE)

# Emit the data as a real JavaScript variable
cat("<script>const imagesArray = ", json_images, ";</script>", sep = "")
```

<div class="gallery-container" style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; max-width:900px; margin:40px auto;">

  <div class="main-stage" style="width:100%; height:60vh; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; background:#000; border-radius:12px; overflow:hidden;">
    <img id="active-view" src="" alt="Loading Gallery..." style="max-width:100%; max-height:100%; object-fit:contain; transition:opacity .2s ease-in-out;">
  </div>

  <div class="navigation-controls" style="display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:40px; margin:20px 0 30px; width:100%;">
    <button class="btn btn-outline-light" id="prev-btn" style="padding:8px 24px; font-size:18px;">&larr;</button>
    <span id="counter-display" style="font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; letter-spacing:1px; color:#aaa;">0 / 0</span>
    <button class="btn btn-outline-light" id="next-btn" style="padding:8px 24px; font-size:18px;">&rarr;</button>
  </div>

  <div class="thumbnail-dock" id="dock-strip" style="display:flex; gap:10px; width:100%; overflow-x:auto; padding-bottom:10px; scroll-behavior:smooth;"></div>

</div>

<script>
let currentIndex = 0;
const activeView = document.getElementById('active-view');
const counterDisplay = document.getElementById('counter-display');
const dockStrip = document.getElementById('dock-strip');

// 1. Build the thumbnail strip
imagesArray.forEach((img, idx) => {
  const t = document.createElement('img');
  t.src = img.thumb;
  t.loading = "lazy";
  t.alt = `Thumbnail ${idx + 1}`;
  t.style = "width:80px; height:60px; object-fit:cover; flex-shrink:0; cursor:pointer; border-radius:6px; opacity:.4; border:2px solid transparent; transition:all .2s ease;";
  t.addEventListener('click', () => updateGallery(idx));
  dockStrip.appendChild(t);
});

// 2. Show a given image and highlight its thumbnail
function updateGallery(newIndex) {
  const thumbs = dockStrip.children;

  if (thumbs[currentIndex]) {
    thumbs[currentIndex].style.opacity = "0.4";
    thumbs[currentIndex].style.borderColor = "transparent";
  }

  currentIndex = newIndex;

  if (thumbs[currentIndex]) {
    thumbs[currentIndex].style.opacity = "1";
    thumbs[currentIndex].style.borderColor = "#00ffff";
    thumbs[currentIndex].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest', inline: 'center' });
  }

  activeView.style.opacity = "0.3";
  activeView.onload = () => { activeView.style.opacity = "1"; };  // set BEFORE src
  activeView.src = imagesArray[currentIndex].full;
  counterDisplay.innerText = `${currentIndex + 1} / ${imagesArray.length}`;
}

// 3. Buttons and keyboard
const nextSlide = () => updateGallery((currentIndex + 1) % imagesArray.length);
const prevSlide = () => updateGallery((currentIndex - 1 + imagesArray.length) % imagesArray.length);

document.getElementById('next-btn').addEventListener('click', nextSlide);
document.getElementById('prev-btn').addEventListener('click', prevSlide);
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') nextSlide();
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') prevSlide();
});

updateGallery(0);
</script>
